title: Independent DWG lineage, route limits, and hardening crosswalk
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and plan-only update
baselineQualification: The shared worktree was already broadly dirty. Local code observations describe the current worktree, not a clean checkout at baselineCommit.
scope: Reconcile independent open-source DWG/DXF implementation lineages and operation/version claims.
Cross-check recent LibreDWG security fixes against local R2004 decompression, page-map, and object-lifetime owners.
Refine optional peer use and next-slice readiness without expanding routine validation, fixtures, or dependencies.

method.kind: Primary-source web review plus local read-only source/test crosswalk
method.limitations: Peer README, NEWS, and main-branch pages are mutable unless pinned. The source crosswalk is static inspection of a pre-existing dirty worktree and is not a sanitizer, fuzz, peer-runtime, or clean-commit reproduction. Peer security reports are not normative DWG evidence. The ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layouts.

sources.revision: 0.14.1 NEWS entry dated 2026-07-25; page reviewed 2026-10-18; no artifact run
sources.observed: Release notes document R2004 decompression allocation-capacity/logical-size drift, pre-R2004 VIEWPORT pointer invalidation across object-table growth, and an R2004 header read using an unvalidated section-page-map offset. They are peer implementation failures, not reproduced libdxfrw defects or semantic results.

sources.revision: Mutable README and coverage report reviewed 2026-10-18; exact commit and peer corpus not pinned or run
sources.observed: The Apache-2.0 project identifies as pre-alpha, distinguishes container/object enumeration from alpha per-entity decoding, and reports a 19-file self-measured corpus with per-version decoded, skipped, and errored counts. It is an independent spec-led reader family but not a qualified DWG writer or broad entity oracle.

sources.revision: Mutable README and reader documentation reviewed 2026-10-18; no release binary run
sources.observed: The current compatibility table is operation/version-specific and lists AC1021 DWG reading but not DWG writing, despite broad read/write project description. Reader notifications provide diagnostics but do not alone establish a complete object-loss ledger or semantic acceptance.

sources.revision: Current README reviewed 2026-10-18; no build or runtime
sources.observed: The project declares DWG reading through LibreDWG FFI, DXF reading through the separate undxf crate, and no DWG/DXF writer. Its DWG route is therefore correlated with LibreDWG; undxf is a separate DXF-only parser route.

sources.revision: Current source/documentation pages reviewed 2026-10-18; no build or runtime
sources.observed: The DWG CAD driver identifies itself as based on libopencad and exposes an OGR feature projection. The DXF driver is a separate route with its own parsing, projection, and writer limits; a GDAL result must be labeled by driver and operation.

localCrosswalk.result: Static current-worktree inspection found bounded output windows and a fresh, section-local decoded allocation published only after all pages succeed. The specific live-buffer shrink sequence is absent by construction; no peer PoC was run and no local defect is established.

localCrosswalk.peerSignal: LibreDWG invalid page-map offset and object pointer invalidation
localOwners: Existing PAR-14/PAR-26 checked page and stable-identity owners
localCrosswalk.result: Current source uses checked offset addition, bounded page parsing and referenced-page range checks. This is a static guard-location observation, not full malformed-input qualification; test only an uncovered invariant if its owning path is changed.

localOwners: Existing fast selector and scheduled composed test checkpoints
localCrosswalk.result: Select one exact peer route per named question at the composed checkpoint; deduplicate wrappers by parser lineage and separate typed read, raw retention, projection, writer output, native acceptance, and B-rep semantics. The immediate local queue remains the LAYOUT viewport-list output contract; no external executable is needed to continue it.

assessment.planImpact: Clarifies peer independence and evidence ceilings, maps fresh peer hardening examples to existing local owners, and preserves the next PAR-20/7G.3 output slice and fast-validation cadence. No local defect, support status, or implementation order changed.
